name: gap-log-provenance-chain-unextendable
title: Restore an extendable B-META gap-log provenance chain after the identity cutover
description: proof-or-stop gap_log refuses every append on this repository: gap_log: existing provenance chain is not extendable (invalid_binding_shape); expected=(none) observed=(none). RED (repro probe rp-mtk465sr-hoyapk, red-reviewed rr-mtk4a7uu-t98f1q, read-only script red-gap-log-provenance-chain.mjs against the real ledger): verifyGapLogArtifactBinding returns trusted=false invalid_binding_shape for three independent reasons left by the .lattice -> .proof-or-stop cutover: (a) the receipt HMAC key at <git-common-dir>/proof-or-stop-gap-log-provenance.key does not exist (the pre-rename lattice-gap-log-provenance.key is absent too; commit 4106eb3531 renamed the path without migrating the key), so expectedReceiptHash is null and no receipt is authentic; (b) all 32 receipts carry artifactPath/ledgerPath literals under .lattice/ while the verifier requires byte-equality with the canonical constants; (c) committedArtifactDigest(receipts[0].parentHead d87f13e887) reads the canonical path in a commit where the artifact only existed under .lattice/, gets null, and demands the canonical-empty genesis digest. Because receipts are HMAC-bound over the path literals and the key is gone, the chain cannot be re-verified in place. Scope: design and implement an explicit, audited one-shot migration (re-anchor the chain with a genesis-reset record that cites the legacy ledger digest and parent head, re-key, canonicalize paths for new receipts), keep the verifier strict (no silent .lattice alias, per the proof-or-stop-residue rules), make gap_log succeed afterwards, and commit the red script as packages/main/tests/red/red-gap-log-provenance-chain.mjs.
